subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Unit 1: New Media – Writing: Describing Charts
outcomes: Name four types of charts: pie, column, line and bar.
Read a chart and describe its data with comparing language.
Write a clear summary of two charts and check it with a checklist.

tf.s: A pie chart is a circle divided into slices.
tf.why: Yes! Each slice shows a part of the whole.

tf.s: A column chart has horizontal bars.
tf.why: A column chart has vertical bars; a bar chart has horizontal bars.

tf.s: A chart summary uses the present simple.
A good chart summary includes the writer's personal opinion.
tf.why: It presents only the data in an objective way.

tf.s: 'However' is a linking word that shows contrast.
tf.why: Well done, it introduces a different idea.

tf.s: The first sentence of a summary gives the type of chart, its topic, who and when.
tf.why: Yes, the introduction tells the reader what the chart is about.

tf.s: A chart summary moves from specific details to the general idea.
tf.why: It moves from general to specific.

tf.s: 'The chart show football are popular' is a correct sentence.
tf.why: The correct sentence is 'The chart shows that football is popular.'

tf.s: You should write about a chart before you read it carefully.
tf.why: Read it first so that your information is accurate.

boxes.q: What is a chart with vertical bars called?
Which tense do we use to describe charts?
Which word is a synonym of 'illustrate'?

boxes.why: 'The least popular' has the smallest number.
'However' introduces a different or opposite idea.

boxes.q: What are the three parts of a chart summary?
boxes.why: A summary has a clear beginning, middle and end.

boxes.q: Which chart shows a change over time with a line?
boxes.why: A line graph connects points over time.

boxes.q: What is the purpose of a writing plan?
o: to check spelling at the end
boxes.why: Planning helps you put ideas in order.

boxes.q: In peer feedback, you give your partner ...
o: a strength and a point to improve
boxes.why: Good feedback is helpful and balanced.

mcq.q: Which of these is NOT one of the four chart types in the lesson?
mcq.why: The four types are pie, column, line and bar.

mcq.q: Does a chart summary include the writer's opinion?
o: No, it presents only the data.

mcq.q: Which words can compare two groups in one sentence?
mcq.why: 'Whereas' and 'while' show a difference between two things.

mcq.q: What do we write in the first sentence of a chart summary?
o: the type of chart, its topic, who and when
mcq.why: The introduction tells the reader what the chart shows.

mcq.q: Choose the best opening sentence for a summary.
o: The two pie charts illustrate the sports played by boys and girls in 2018.
mcq.why: It gives the chart type, topic, who and when.

mcq.q: Rewrite: 'Snapchat is popular with women. Twitter is not as popular.'
o: Snapchat is more popular with women than Twitter.
Twitter is more popular with women than Snapchat.
Snapchat is as popular as Twitter with women.
Snapchat is the least popular with women.
mcq.why: 'More … than' shows Snapchat has more users.

mcq.q: Use 'while' to compare boys and girls correctly.
o: While boys prefer football, girls prefer swimming.
While boys football, girls swimming prefer.
While boys prefers football, girls prefers swimming.
mcq.why: 'While' joins two contrasting ideas in one sentence.

mcq.q: Which sentence is correct for a chart summary?
o: The chart shows that football is popular.
The chart show football are popular.
I think the chart is boring.
The chart showed football will be popular.
mcq.why: Present simple, correct agreement and no opinion.

mcq.q: Why should you read a chart carefully before writing?
o: To find its type, topic and trend so your facts are accurate.
mcq.why: Understanding the chart keeps your summary accurate.

mcq.q: Action books have the biggest slice. Which sentence is correct?
o: Action books are more popular than any other books.
Action books are the least popular.
Action books are not as popular as poetry.
All books are as popular as each other.
mcq.why: The biggest slice means the most popular.
